book.name: Matiu
book.title: Cau Amsǝban a nê mala MATIU

content: Yesu kutio a Urǝshalima
Lang Yesu andǝ alaggana male gbàshìnà Urǝshalima ka à yì kara a muna-là mǝnana à tunǝi ama Betafaji, mana amur Nkono mala anggun Olif ka. Yesu túr alaggana male ɓari.
Banggia wia ama,

content.text: <<Wu kyane a muna-là mana a ɓadǝm wun ngga. Wun nǝ̀ kútí ani ka, wun nǝ̀ nggá kum mǝdambǝriso à kùrni nǝ muni atè. Wu panzǝi wu yinǝàm nǝi.
Ɓǝ̀ kǝɓwa na wun kǝ cau ka, wu ne wi ama, Mǝtalabangŋo kǝ earcea. Nǝ̀ ɗekia wunia tù.>>

content: Mǝnia ka pa anggo ace mǝnana ɓǝà lùmsǝ ɓangnǝa mala Zakariya mǝnana ama:

content.text: <<Wu ne amǝ Urǝshalima ama,
Wu sǝni, murǝm ma'wun
ndya kǝ yiu a ban wun ngga!
Yì ka, mǝ'nwangsǝ-muru na,
kǝ yiu a nzǝm dambǝritso.
A nzǝm muna-dambǝritso
sǝ kǝ gya.>>

content: Pǝlǝa alaggana man wario à kya pak gìr mǝnana Yesu túriá ace ka.
À kya yiu nǝ dambǝritso andǝ muni. À makkia anggubyau malea a nzǝmia, pǝlǝa Yesu eauwe do.
Ɓwabunda kǝ̀rkǝ́r sárǝ́ki anggubyau malea a tanjargula, acilia man ngga à kasǝki abu-nggun à nongsǝkia a tanjargula.
Aɓwabundǝa mǝnana a ɓadǝmbi andǝ amana a nzǝmi ka à loasǝ già ama,

content.text: <<Wu ɓwangsǝ Mǝkà Dauda!
Tsǝkbu mala Ɓakuli
nda muri,
yì ɓwa mǝnana kǝ yiu
aɓa lullǝ Mǝtalabangŋo ka!
Ɓǝà ɓwangsǝki Ɓakuli
akanó a kùli!>>

content: Lang Yesu kutina a Urǝshalima ka, nggea-là kat lo came amur kusǝì. Ɓwapǝndǝa ɗiban ama, <<Yana ɓwe nda man le?>>
Aɓwabundǝa ear ama, <<Mǝnia ka Yesu na, Mǝɓangnǝa mala Ɓakuli mǝnana pur a Nazarat, a bu-nzali Galili ka.>>
Yesu pǝr amǝ kúrkúró aɓa Ndàmǝgule
Lang Yesu kutio aɓa Ndàmǝgule mala Ɓakuli ka, pǝr amǝ'kúrkúró andǝ amǝ makkiagir, ramgita atebǝl mala amǝ nggaɗi boalo, sukkia, andǝ abuno mala amǝ makki akutumurǝm.
Nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Malǝmce mala Ɓakuli bang ama,
<< <Ɓala mem ngga
à nǝ̀ tunǝi ama
ndà ace pak hiwi,>
sǝ wu nyesǝi duk mpu
mala amǝ'ɓǝmbǝriban!>>

content: Ante andǝ agbakǝre yiu a baní aɓa Ndàmǝgule mala Ɓakuli, yi twalia wia ban akwánó malea.

Lang agbani pǝris andǝ amǝkani Nggurcau sǝn agir-ndali mǝnana peǎ, andǝ amuna mana à kǝ pak banɓoarnado aɓa Ndàmǝgule mala Ɓakuli ama, <<Ɓwangsǝkiban ngga dumǝna mala Muna mala Dauda>> ka, bumia lúllô.
Pǝlǝa à ɗì Yesu ama, <<A nǝ́ nggǝ̀ ok cau mǝnana amuna mǝnia kǝ ne ka?>> Earia wia ama,

content.text: <<E, Mǝ nda ǝn nggǝ oea ka, sǝ wun ngga wu ɓalli mbo aɓa Malǝmce mala Ɓakuli ama,
<< <À tsǝk ɓwangsǝkiban
a kún amuna mǝkèke
andǝ abangna-muna?>

content: Pǝlǝa nyia purî ɓá nggea-là o a Betani, a kàm sǝ kya nongŋo.
Yesu su nggun vwari
Nǝ dǝmbari ɗiɗyal Yesu nyàrî Betani, nda ban ká a Urǝshalima ka, nzala wali.
Mǝsǝì kpa arǝ nggun vwari a girǝi njargula, pǝlǝa sana wari a tǝrí. Sǝ kya kum kǝ ɓǝle ɗàng, mbui na nǝmurǝì. Pǝlǝa ne nggun ama,

content.text: <<A pà nǝ́ ɓǝl ɗǝm ɗàng!>>

content: Àkǝ̀ banì kara nggunî ime.
Alaggana nǝ̀ yia sǝni ka gìr nî pakkia wia gir'ndali gandǝa à ɗiban ama, <<Lang sǝ nggun vwari man kaurǝ ime anggo?>>
Yesu nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Ɓafo, ǝn nggǝ na wun, ɓǝ̀ wu ndanǝ paɓamuru sǝ wu tuti aɓa ɗenyicau raka, mǝnia yì gìr à pakki nggun ngga nda mana nǝmurǝì wun nǝ̀ gandǝ pe ka ɗàng. Ɓǝ̀ wun nǝ̀ ne mǝnia yì nkono ama, <Lo, kya kpa aɓa nggeamùr> ka, anggo sǝ nǝ̀ pa.
Gìr mǝnana kat wu zǝmba aɓa hiwi nǝ paɓamuru ka, wun nǝ̀ kumi.>>

content: Amǝ Farisi ɗì Yesu amurbangŋo male

Yesu kutio aɓa Ndàmǝgule mala Ɓakuli; lang nda ban kanigir ka agbani pǝris andǝ aɓwana-mǝgule mala amǝ Yahudi yiu a baní sǝ à ɗì ama, <<Nǝ́ yà bangŋo sǝ a kǝ pakki amǝnia yì agir ka, sǝ yana po bangŋo mala pakki agir nì?>>
Yesu pǝlǝa earia wia ama,

content.text: <<Mǝ nǝ ɗì wun cau gbal mwashat, ɓǝ̀ wu panam eare ka sǝ mǝ nǝ bangga wun ko nǝ ya bangŋo sǝ ǝn nggǝ pakki amǝnia yì agir ka.
Batisǝma mala Yohana ka, pur nǝ kǝshe? Pur nǝ ban Ɓakuli le ko pur nǝ ban ɓwapǝndǝa?>>

content: À kùtí a pǝlǝki ce arǝarǝia ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ sǝm na ama, <Pur nǝ ban Ɓakuli> ka, nǝ̀ bangga sǝm ama, <Sǝ palang sǝ wu ginǝ earnǝi?>
Sǝ ɓǝ̀ sǝm bang gbal ama, <Pur nǝ ban ɓwapǝndǝa> ka ɓangciu kǝ pakka sǝm arǝ aɓwana, acemǝnana ɓwapǝndǝa kat sǝlǝna ama Yohana ka mǝɓangnǝa mala Ɓakuli na.>>
Ace mani ka à ne wi ama, <<Sǝm sǝlǝ ɗang.>> Yesu pǝlǝa nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Mim gbal ka pà mǝ nǝ na wun ko nǝ ya bangŋo sǝ ǝn nggǝ pakki amǝnia yì agir ka ɗàng.

content: Kanicau arǝ amuna ɓari

content.text: <<Sǝ mana nda ɗenyicau ma'wun amur mǝnia yì cau mǝ nǝ bangga wun ngga? Ɓè ɓwa nakam nǝ amuna-burana ɓari. Wario a ban muna-dǝmba sǝ ne wi ama, <Munem, kya ɓaban kya paktúró kam yalung.>
<<Muna pǝlǝa ne tárrí ama, <Pa mǝ nǝ ká ɗàng.> Sǝa ma nǝnzǝ́mò ka ɓalki ɓabumi pǝlǝa wario.
<<Tár amuna pǝlǝa kutio a ban ɓaria muni sǝ kya ne wi kǝcau mǝ'mwashati. Yì ka, earî tárrí ama nǝ̀ ká, sǝ wari ɗang.
<<Aɓalǝ amuna mǝnia ɓari ka yana pak gìr mǝnana tárrí earce ka?>>

content: Pǝlǝa à earî Yesu ama mǝdǝmba na. Yesu pǝlǝa nea wia ama:

content.text: Ən nggǝ bangga wun mǝsǝcau, amǝ'aki aboalo-cemi andǝ amā-gung à nǝ̀ akà wun dǝmba kutio a Domurǝm mala Ɓakuli.
Yohana Mǝbatisǝma yiu yi kania wun tanjar mǝɓafoe, sǝ wu earnǝi ɗàng; sǝ amǝ'aki aboalo-cemi aɓa andǝ amā-gung earnǝi. Kat andǝ mǝnana wu sǝn mǝnia ka, wu nggaɗi ɗenyicau ma'wun wu earnǝi ɗàng.

content: Kanicau arǝ amǝtúró manaà tsǝia sǝn ɓaban ngga

content.text: Wu kwaki kir wun arǝ ɓè kanicau. Ɓè mǝ'rya tsǝk ɓaban anap, kàrì nǝ nkāndan, tǝm tūli kamggi anap aɓalǝi sǝ ɓak ban mǝ'dāhre ace mǝ'yale. Nyinggi aɓea amǝ'rya a buia ɓǝà kǝ sǝnbi wi, pǝlǝa o a bǝri.
Kunɓǝla mala anap yi karna ka, túr aɓea amuna-ɓala male ɓǝà kya aki wi ɓǝla anap a bu amǝ'yál ɓaban.
Amǝ'rya yi bwal amuna-ɓala man. Mwashat ka à walki, ɓè ka à wali wú, sǝ ɓè man ngga à ɓukki nǝ atali.
Mǝtala-ɓaban nyare tasǝ aɓea amuna-ɓala mana à làkkì à kútì amǝdǝmba ka. Kǝgìr mǝ'mwashati na amǝ'rya man yi pakkia wia ka.
A masǝlǝate ka, pǝlǝa túr muni a bania. A nê male ka à nǝ̀ pè muni gulo.
Lang amǝ'rya man nǝ yia sǝn muni ka, à nea rǝia ama, <<Mǝliɓala nya kǝ yiu ka. Sǝm nǝ̀ yia wal-luí ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ ɓaban duk ma'sǝm!>>
Pǝlǝa à yì bwali à túrí a nzǝm nkāndan ɓaban sǝ à wali wú.
Sǝ ɓǝ̀ mǝtala ɓaban yiu ado ka, mana gir nì na nǝ̀ yia pangnǝ amǝ'rya mǝnia ka?

content: Agbani pǝris andǝ aɓwana-mǝgule earî wi ama, <<Nǝ̀ yia wal-lú amǝ'rya amǝ'ɓealɓikea man, sǝ nǝ̀ ak ɓaban nǝ̀ pea amǝ'rya mǝnana à nǝ̀ pè wi ɓǝlanggun ɓaban ɓǝ̀ kunɓǝle karna ka.>>
Yesu pǝlǝa nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Wu ɓal cau mana Malǝmce mala Ɓakuli bang ngga re? Mǝnana ama,
<< <Tali mana amǝɓa ginǝi ka,
nda yi pǝlǝ mǝɓoarne kat-kat ka.
Mǝnia ka pé mala Ɓakuli na;
Gìr ndali na a ban sǝm.>
<<Sǝ ǝn nggǝ na wun ama Domurǝm mala Ɓakuli ka, à nǝ̀ é arǝ wun à nǝ̀ pè aɓwana mǝnana à nǝ̀ pak gìr mana Ɓakuli earkiyice ka.
Ɓwa man kat kpa amur tali man ngga nǝ̀ ɓungio. Sǝ ɓwa mana tali man kpa amurí ka nǝ̀ betǝki.>>

content: Lang agbani pǝris andǝ amǝ Farisi yi ok akanicau mala Yesu, sǝ à yì sǝlǝ ama nda arǝ bangcau amúrià ka,
à alte ama à nǝ̀ bwali, sǝ ɓangciu pakkia wia arǝ aɓwana, acemǝnana ɓwapǝndǝa pas earǝna ama Yesu ka mǝɓangnǝa na.

footnotes.text: Ɓalli gbal aɓa: Mat 23:11; Mar 9:35; Luk 22:26.
